task_instance: Act on the brand-scout workflow for a sample brief (a lightweight auto-tax-saving budgeting app for freelancers): run discovery, brainstorm 15-20 name candidates, then produce the final brand research report with automated name scores, domain availability, and social-media handle status for the top candidates.
blocker_detail: The core deliverable (the Step 7 report) depends on three mandatory bundled Python scripts that the skill instructs you to run: the name scorer (Step 3), the domain-availability checker (Step 5), and the social-media handle checker (Step 6). This office-assistant runtime cannot run code or shell commands of any kind, so none of these scripts can be executed. The skill-specific rule forbids writing my own replacement/stub for a bundled script or fabricating its output. In addition, the domain checker fundamentally needs live DNS/WHOIS network access and the handle checker needs live network requests to platform sites, and this round's rules forbid web fetch/search, so the availability data could not be obtained even by hand. Discovery, brainstorm, and the qualitative rubric narrative can be done with text tools alone, but the scored/availability sections that are the skill's stated purpose (securing domains and handles) cannot be produced or verified.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and confirmed all referenced skill files exist via Glob: scripts/score_names.py, scripts/check_domains.py, scripts/check_handles.py, references/brand-guide.xml, references/tld-guide.xml. Inspected the two script headers: score_names.py is a Python CLI (argparse) producing automated scores; check_domains.py imports socket/subprocess and performs DNS lookups plus WHOIS, i.e. it needs code execution and network. Completed the achievable text-only parts as a genuine attempt: wrote discovery.md (sample brief) and brainstorm.md (18 candidates grouped by naming pattern). Attempt stopped at Step 3: the runtime grants no code execution, so score_names.py / check_domains.py / check_handles.py cannot be run, and the report's Name Analysis scores, Domain Availability table, and Social Media Handles table cannot be filled or verified. No real deliverable report exists. Files produced: discovery.md, brainstorm.md, result.json in the work directory.
